mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','COMPLETED') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END),0) sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING'),0) pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='PAID'),0) paid_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='SHIPPED'),0) shipped_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='COMPLETED'),0) completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='CANCELLED'),0) cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='REFUNDING'),0) refunding_count FROM sales_order
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty),0) available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(available_qty <= reorder_point),0) low_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sku) sku_count FROM inventory
SELECT i.*,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT pi.*,s.code sku_code FROM purchase_order_item pi JOIN sku s ON s.id=pi.sku_id WHERE pi.purchase_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY pi.id
SELECT r.*,o.order_no,c.name customer_name FROM return_order r JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=r.customer_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
SELECT ri.*,i.sku_id,s.code sku_code FROM return_item ri JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.id=ri.order_item_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE ri.return_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY ri.id
